=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:7651-7666 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The host-only subcase of test_intake_verified_sandbox_report_without_eligible_issue_keeps_todays_outcome reuses the `env` whose identity file was deleted by the first intake (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:377), so the second run rejects with report_auth=rejected reason=identity_missing.
  WHY: The assertion at line 7666 fails and turns tests-heal-plan-and-validation and the lint aggregate red (CI run 38509968307). Reviewers labeled it BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:340-344 (with workflow-level concurrency 65-71) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The recovery-scan job joins the shared `workflow-failure-heal-intake` concurrency group, so a pending scan and a pending report intake can displace each other even with cancel-in-progress false.
  WHY: A displaced repository_dispatch report is not re-sent, and a 95-minute scan holds the lock. This contradicts the documented intent that a pending scan never replaces a pending report. Reviewers labeled it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:233-273 vs 345-420 (recovery-scan job) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The recovery-scan job lacks the Resolve AI engine, Install Claude Code CLI and Claude credential steps and the AI_ENGINE / AI_ENGINE_WORKFLOW_HEAL / SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE env that the intake job has.
  WHY: claude_run_selected fails or refuses fallback, so replacement issues get a raw-context inconclusive diagnosis or the intake fails, and the AI_ENGINE overrides are ignored. Reviewers labeled it MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:146, 197-204, 231-233 (MAX_EXAMINED=20, first:50) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The scan lists only the oldest 50 candidates and examines at most 20 per tick with no pagination, and exhausted or permanently skipped issues stay at the head. Permanent skips also consume the per-tick slot, so later candidates such as #7082 are starved.
  WHY: Later recoverable markerless issues are delayed or never reached. Reviewers labeled it MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:145-168 (--list-only COUNT) with .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:339 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The count gating the recovery-scan job includes exhausted and ineligible candidates that the loop will skip.
  WHY: The heavy 95-minute job runs hourly with no recoverable work. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (anthropic, minimax) and NIT (z-ai); the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:211-220, 256-287 (with scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2684, 2807-2811) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unedited-issue check uses the scan-start lastEditedAt snapshot, and the intake's recovery check passes last_edited_at=None, so an issue edited mid-scan can still be replaced and closed.
  WHY: This is a freshness gap in the edit guard. Severity disagreement: NIT (anthropic, z-ai) vs MAJOR (gemini, minimax, openai); the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:683-688 (with 972-989) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When NON_RETRYABLE_RECOVERY_DEFERRED=true the intake continues into the heal-issue listings, which can `exit 1` on a transient list failure.
  WHY: The run goes red with a CRITICAL notification even though the PR-side outcome was already delivered. Reviewers labeled it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:239-255 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: SOURCE_REPO and SOURCE_NUMBER are captured from the issue body and passed to a gh api GET with GH_PAT before the is_valid_repo_slug check.
  WHY: An edited body could redirect reads to another repo the PAT can read. Reviewer labeled it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: AD-1 states "the scan stops unless `REPORT_AUTH=verified`" for the reconstructed-report path.
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh `recovery_scan` auth case and `_heal_scope_recovery_evaluate`
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:331 sets REPORT_AUTH=reconstructed and line 1085 accepts verified or reconstructed, so no path grants the literal `verified` value.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:~7660-7666 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The host-only subcase reuses `env` after the first intake deleted the identity file (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:377), so it rejects with identity_missing.
  WHY: The assertion fails and CI goes red. The production deferral is correct, and the qwen and gemini claims that it is wrong misread the CI output.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:340-343, 65-71 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The recovery-scan job shares the workflow-level concurrency group, so a pending scan and a pending report can displace each other.
  WHY: A displaced repository_dispatch report is lost.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:COUNT/--list-only/main loop | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The count includes exhausted, ineligible, edited and permanent-skip issues, and a permanent skip consumes a PROCESSED slot.
  WHY: The hourly job does no work and later candidates (#7082) are delayed. MAX_EXAMINED=20 and first:50 mean later candidates are never reached.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:~345-420 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The recovery-scan job lacks the engine resolution, Claude CLI and credential steps, and the AI_ENGINE* and SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE env.
  WHY: claude_run_selected fails and the diagnosis falls back to raw context (inconclusive). The AI_ENGINE overrides are ignored.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:~683-688, 972-989 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The deferred path continues into the heal-issue listings, which `exit 1` on a transient list failure.
  WHY: The run ends red despite the already-determined "no eligible issue" outcome.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh, scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The never-edited check uses the scan-start snapshot, and the intake re-check does not re-check lastEditedAt.
  WHY: An issue edited between the list and the closing step could still be replaced. The window is short and the fingerprint checks still apply.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:683-688 | severity=NIT | confidence=3

- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:65-71 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
